I farm with my own hands, and with only one person in the household I will keep the plan simple, familiar, and manageable. I will still plant all five crops, but I will put the most land into chili because that is my main cropping pattern and it brings me cash if I manage water and pests well. I will keep some wheat and garlic because they fit my habit of spreading risk across seasons, and I will keep smaller areas of cotton and watermelon so I am not relying on only one market. Since I have well irrigation, I will use water to protect establishment and key growth stages, but I will not push inputs too hard because I need a plan I can actually manage alone. I will use better seed where I trust it to pay back, keep tillage mostly rotary because it is practical on my scale, and aim for steady yields instead of chasing the highest possible output.
